user_objective: Accurate realtime passage counting on PYNQ-Z2; agent chooses resolution and FPS; use existing datasets without further questions.
selection_data: Aug19 and Aug15 development, including first 11/12 realtime fast-cow failure; Aug14 is a known regression; Aug20 remains untouched.
clock_selection_rationale: The earlier 500ms observation p95 and 250ms capture limits were agent-selected engineering targets, not user requirements. Preserve every historical realtime_clock_pass result. This practical service contract is fixed before subsequent complete regression runs and the untouched Aug20 inference; it does not relabel any old run.
accuracy: Each available user-confirmed directional total must match. Reference totals are not supplied to the counting process. Recorded trajectories and event videos must be inspected for obvious duplicate/canceling errors; no timed-event precision/recall is claimed without independent timed GT.
input_scope: Prepared full-FOV camera-format MJPEG input arrives at 1x wall time; all online decode, crop, rotation, model input prep, O8, tracking, counting and JSONL publication run on PYNQ. Dataset adaptation to a selected capture format occurs offline on PC and is not an online board operation.
hardware_scope: Existing O8 at 100MHz on PYNQ-Z2. No physical camera is attached. This is live-paced video replay, not a physical camera transport qualification.

candidate.endpoint_recovery: causal actual-image reacquisition, max1 extra call per processed frame, max8 attempts per origin, max age1.5s

held_out: Camera2 Aug20: user UP12 before any Aug20 inference. Same farm/camera as Aug19, new date; not cross-farm. No parameter selection from Aug20 predictions. DOWN reference remains null.
